rule: One headword per word root. A form that shares another headword's root is not counted as a separate headword: it is listed in that headword's WORD_FAMILY note and its own row carries family:merged plus family-head:<id>. Inflections, spelling variants and derivations all follow this rule, so the headword count is a count of roots.

kinds.derived: the member is a derivational form of the head
kinds.same root: the member shares the head's root but is not a direct derivation (a cognate or sibling form)
kinds.inflection: the member is an inflection or spelling variant of the head
